Finding submitted.

**Deviation (high severity) — § 12.4 (p0050)**

§ 12.4 imposes on us a non-compete that (i) runs 24 months past termination, (ii) covers "any product or service that competes with Vendor," (iii) applies "in any territory," and (iv) expressly bars acquisitions. That fails the fallback on every material term (named product, term-only, 12-month cap, internal-development/acquisition carve-outs) and lands in walk-away territory. It also contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment.

Redline (validated, preferred level): delete § 12.4 in full, with the narrowed fallback offered in the comment as a negotiating path.
